rationale: The duplicate is in an ignored extra-metadata object, and both values are identical. The clarifications say duplicate keys ANYWHERE give 2/evidence_audit_input_invalid, and that extra metadata is permitted and ignored but never overrides normative fields. Ignoring metadata semantically does not exempt it from JSON validity. This kills two weaker mutants: one that checks duplicates only in normative fields, and one that rejects only conflicting duplicate values. Either would return 0/evidence_audit_clean because the normative content is a valid clean receipt.
